mechanism.claim: When quote turnover attached to up versus down minute candles has the same strong polarity in both halves of a volatile completed BTC block, participation is persistently sponsoring one direction rather than reflecting one isolated shock. Follow that direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of first-half and second-half signed quote-turnover balances
mechanism.why_distinct: Aggressive-flow candidates use taker fields; range-participation weights signed range energy; return-volume covariance uses continuous return magnitude; dominant-volume candidates select one bar. HVDHSVPR uses candle-sign-assigned quote turnover separately in two fixed halves, ranks the weaker half, and uses no taker flow, endpoint return, range weight, funding, OI, cross-asset, prior event, fitted outcome, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35% while both halves independently show same-side turnover sponsorship
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily dual-half signed-volume clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.minute_return: log(close/open), finite; sign zero retained with zero signed contribution
features.half_balance: for each fixed 240-minute half, sum(quote_asset_volume*sign(minute_return))/sum(quote_asset_volume), requiring finite nonnegative turnover and strict positive denominator
features.dual_half_persistence: both balances strict nonzero with the same sign
features.strength_rank: strict-prior midrank of weak_half_strength over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.55
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared minute returns), finite strict positive
features.eligible_state: dual-half persistence plus strength and variation gates
features.event_clock: every eligible fixed boundary; no onset filter

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: same-side quote-turnover sponsorship in both fixed halves

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no volume field, half split, sign rule, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
